claims_supported: Federation statements are anchored in Trust Anchors; entities may belong to multiple federations.
An Entity Statement is a signed JWT; Entity Configuration is self-issued and Subordinate Statement is issued by a superior.
Entity Statement validation covers type, signature, issuer/subject, authority hints, iat/exp, JWKS and trust-chain syntax.
Trust chains link adjacent statements by issuer/subject and signature, ending at a Trust Anchor.
Metadata is keyed by Entity Type and federation_entity metadata defines fetch/list/resolve endpoints.
limitations: Scoped four-section read, not full spec.
No signature verification or JWT decoding.
Live page hash pins only this retrieval.
